shared_elements: low-relief carving of figural/object subject matter
horizontal band of repeated decorative motif along the lower edge (rosette/petal or scale-like border)
decorative rows of small repeated units (beading, fringe, patterned bands)
justification: Both are shallow relief scenes with fine repeated ornamental banding — notably a row of petal/rosette-like units running along the bottom edge and beaded/fringed detailing — and both render surface pattern with dense small repeated units in a comparable low-relief convention. But the depicted subjects differ almost entirely: A shows two facing human figures in profile holding vessels and weapons, while B shows a large multi-spoked chariot wheel with hub and studded rim, with no complete figures visible.
